regions.title: Wasatch
regions.text: Brighton is forecast for about 40". Solitude and Snowbasin follow. Winter Weather Advisory at Brighton from Thursday to Saturday.

regions.title: Tahoe
regions.text: Kirkwood is forecast for about 39", 30" of it Thursday. Sugar Bowl and Palisades follow. Winter Storm Warning at Kirkwood from Thursday to Friday.

regions.title: Eastern Sierra
regions.text: Mammoth is forecast for about 27", 24" of it Thursday. Winter Storm Warning at Mammoth from Thursday to Friday.

regions.title: Coast Mountains
regions.text: Cypress Mountain is forecast for about 25", 14" of it Tuesday. Whistler follows. Environment Canada has rain mixed in at Whistler Tuesday.

regions.title: Northern Rockies
regions.text: Grand Targhee is forecast for about 23". Jackson Hole and Sun Valley follow.

regions.title: Cascades
regions.text: Crystal Mountain is forecast for about 17", 12" of it Tuesday. Mt. Baker and Stevens Pass follow.

regions.title: Central Rockies
regions.text: Telluride is forecast for about 12", 7" of it Saturday. Aspen Highlands and Crested Butte follow. The NWS is calling for more at Aspen Highlands: 3 to 9 inches Thursday night through Monday night.

regions.title: Southern Rockies
regions.text: Wolf Creek is forecast for about 10", 5" of it Friday. Taos follows. The NWS is calling for more at Wolf Creek: 7 to 17 inches Thursday night through Monday night.

sources.name: NOAA buoys 51001 / 51101 (method: Powder Buoy, Mike Ruzek)

buoy.text: Buoys 51001 and 51101 near Hawaii popped Nov 11, the swell signal Powder Buoy watches for a Wasatch storm about two weeks later — here Nov 22–28. In past winters a pop raised the chance of a Wasatch storm in that window by roughly 6 to 12 points. Experimental: promising, not proven.
